name: Tsunan (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tsunan town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing the characters つなん.
history: Municipal flag of Tsunan, a town in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1970.

features.role: Tsunan town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing the characters つなん
